method: Hand-authored crosswalk (judgment, confidence C unless noted). Family ids, descriptions, composes_with and facets are read by script from WK place-first-cartography.json; this file adds only Russian/English names, kind, applicable M2c natural layers and template refs. Template refs must resolve in infra/world-base/*.seed.json or the regional-environment candidate (checked by validate.mjs).

layer_vocabulary.rule: The 9 M2c natural presence layers are the 13 layer keys minus the 4 ambient keys seasonal_state, light, weather, audible_context, whose live values belong to runtime owners (candidate.json nonblocking_limits[1]).

facet_slots.rule: Four-facet families list facets in the order ground/material, use/people, senses/traces, risks/upkeep (checked on all 4-facet families of place-first-cartography); the position gives the slot. Families with 1, 2 or 5 facets use the explicit overrides below.

landscape:lt_dry_ravine_gully.existing_nearest_data: Forest edge has relief and scrub, but no ravine landform or dry gully access.
landscape:lt_dry_ravine_gully.why_insufficient: A wooded edge does not express the steep eroded sides, shelter and obstructed crossing of a dry ravine.
landscape:lt_dry_ravine_gully.minimum_data_delta: Author dry-ravine relief and crossing limits at the place-first owner, then add lt_dry_ravine_gully to that PF or a ravine PF.

landscape:lt_seasonally_flooded_forest.existing_nearest_data: Mixed woodland covers wooded floodplain and wet lowland forest, with water and tree layers.
landscape:lt_seasonally_flooded_forest.why_insufficient: Neither ref specifies periodic inundation or the change from dry access to dangerous flood conditions.
landscape:lt_seasonally_flooded_forest.minimum_data_delta: Author seasonal inundation and access limits for mixed woodland, then add lt_seasonally_flooded_forest to its landscape refs.

landscape:lt_steep_hills.existing_nearest_data: No current PF has steep-hill relief; arable field and homestead only cite gentle hills.
landscape:lt_steep_hills.why_insufficient: Gentle cultivated slopes cannot represent steep terrain, exposure and difficult movement.
landscape:lt_steep_hills.minimum_data_delta: Author a steep-hill place-first environment family and add lt_steep_hills to its landscape refs.

landscape:lt_wet_ravine_gully.existing_nearest_data: Marshy stream has wet ground, bank and water layers but no incised ravine relief.
landscape:lt_wet_ravine_gully.why_insufficient: Wet lowland stream facets omit the ravine walls, erosion and constrained access.
landscape:lt_wet_ravine_gully.minimum_data_delta: Author wet-ravine relief and access limits for marshy stream, then add lt_wet_ravine_gully to its landscape refs.

landscape:lt_wooded_hills.existing_nearest_data: Mixed woodland has tree and relief layers but its landscape refs describe lowland or floodplain forest.
landscape:lt_wooded_hills.why_insufficient: The existing woodland does not state hill gradients or wooded-slope travel risks.
landscape:lt_wooded_hills.minimum_data_delta: Author wooded-hill relief and movement for mixed woodland, then add lt_wooded_hills to its landscape refs.

water_body:wb_brine_spring.existing_nearest_data: No current PF represents a saline point source; marshy stream and seep refs describe fresh wetland water.
water_body:wb_brine_spring.why_insufficient: A freshwater seep would misstate salinity, drinkability and salt-resource use.
water_body:wb_brine_spring.minimum_data_delta: Author a brine-source place-first family with saline-water and salt-use limits, then add wb_brine_spring to its water refs.

water_body:wb_fishpond.existing_nearest_data: Fishing camp supports fishing and lake shore supports standing freshwater edges.
water_body:wb_fishpond.why_insufficient: Neither PF states managed pond water, dams, ownership or aquaculture; a fishpond is not a wild lake.
water_body:wb_fishpond.minimum_data_delta: Author managed-pond conditions at the place-first owner, then add wb_fishpond to the fitting PF water refs.

water_body:wb_spring.existing_nearest_data: Marshy stream cites wb_seep, the closest point-source water ref.
water_body:wb_spring.why_insufficient: A seep in marshland does not establish a potable freshwater spring at hills, forest or settlements.
water_body:wb_spring.minimum_data_delta: Author spring emergence and drinking/access limits at the place-first owner, then add wb_spring to a fitting PF water ref.

land_use:lu_clay_extraction.existing_nearest_data: Riverbank contains alluvial material; ordinary workshop includes a clay-pit/pottery place ref.
land_use:lu_clay_extraction.why_insufficient: Neither PF land-use refs state extraction pits, clay removal or its movement hazards.
land_use:lu_clay_extraction.minimum_data_delta: Author clay extraction conditions at the place-first owner and add lu_clay_extraction to a suitable PF land-use ref.

land_use:lu_dye_medicinal_crop_plot.existing_nearest_data: Orchard garden has planted beds and cultivated plant layers.
land_use:lu_dye_medicinal_crop_plot.why_insufficient: Its garden and fruit refs do not specify specialized dye or medicinal crops and their processing.
land_use:lu_dye_medicinal_crop_plot.minimum_data_delta: Author specialty crop beds at the place-first owner, then add lu_dye_medicinal_crop_plot to orchard garden land-use refs.

land_use:lu_fishpond_aquaculture.existing_nearest_data: Fishing camp has capture fishing and fish-weir operation refs.
land_use:lu_fishpond_aquaculture.why_insufficient: Capture fishing does not express managed pond stocking, water control, dams or ownership.
land_use:lu_fishpond_aquaculture.minimum_data_delta: Author managed aquaculture conditions at the place-first owner, then add lu_fishpond_aquaculture to an appropriate PF land-use ref.

land_use:lu_open_field_strip_cultivation.existing_nearest_data: Arable field supports rainfed cultivation; field margin covers boundaries.
land_use:lu_open_field_strip_cultivation.why_insufficient: Neither establishes communal strip allocation and shared field access.
land_use:lu_open_field_strip_cultivation.minimum_data_delta: Author strip-field organization and boundary use at the place-first owner, then add lu_open_field_strip_cultivation to arable field land-use refs.

land_use:lu_saltmaking_saltern.existing_nearest_data: Workshop covers tools, smoke and fire; riverbank covers water access.
land_use:lu_saltmaking_saltern.why_insufficient: Neither has saline water handling, evaporation or salt-work production conditions.
land_use:lu_saltmaking_saltern.minimum_data_delta: Author a saltmaking place-first family with saline source and fire risks, then add lu_saltmaking_saltern to its land-use refs.

land_use:lu_sand_gravel_extraction.existing_nearest_data: Riverbank has bank structure and natural-material layers.
land_use:lu_sand_gravel_extraction.why_insufficient: Natural sediment presence does not establish extraction pits, spoil heaps and unstable excavated banks.
land_use:lu_sand_gravel_extraction.minimum_data_delta: Author bank-material extraction conditions for riverbank, then add lu_sand_gravel_extraction to its land-use refs.

land_use:lu_stone_quarrying.existing_nearest_data: No current PF describes a quarry or exposed rock extraction; woodland and riverbank do not imply a stone resource.
land_use:lu_stone_quarrying.why_insufficient: Adding a quarry use to those environments would invent geology and hazardous working faces.
land_use:lu_stone_quarrying.minimum_data_delta: Author a quarry place-first family grounded in rock geology, then add lu_stone_quarrying to its land-use refs.

place:pt_ford_place.existing_nearest_data: Bridge crossing has bank and crossing layers; ferry landing has an rt_ford route ref.
place:pt_ford_place.why_insufficient: Neither place ref denotes a shallow wadeable bed without bridge or ferry service.
place:pt_ford_place.minimum_data_delta: Author ford-bed and water-depth access limits at the place-first owner, then add pt_ford_place to a crossing PF place ref.

place:pt_pilgrimage_shrine.existing_nearest_data: Churchyard covers religious outdoor space around church and pogost.
place:pt_pilgrimage_shrine.why_insufficient: A pilgrimage shrine may be a distinct destination without churchyard or resident clergy.
place:pt_pilgrimage_shrine.minimum_data_delta: Author shrine visitation and access at the place-first owner, then add pt_pilgrimage_shrine to a suitable PF place ref.

place:pt_portage_place.existing_nearest_data: Road covers overland movement; riverbank covers waterside landing conditions.
place:pt_portage_place.why_insufficient: Neither captures carrying boats and loads between waterways across one route node.
place:pt_portage_place.minimum_data_delta: Author portage transfer conditions at the place-first owner, then add pt_portage_place to a route/water-edge PF place ref.

place:pt_saltworks.existing_nearest_data: Ordinary workshop has work bay, tools and fire facets but no saltworks place ref.
place:pt_saltworks.why_insufficient: Generic craft production omits brine source, boiling house and salt storage.
place:pt_saltworks.minimum_data_delta: Author saltworks conditions at the place-first owner, then add pt_saltworks to a fitting PF place ref.

place:pt_toll_customs_post.existing_nearest_data: Town courtyard includes administrative court and people-use space.
place:pt_toll_customs_post.why_insufficient: A toll post can stand at a road, ferry or border and needs authority and controlled-route conditions.
place:pt_toll_customs_post.minimum_data_delta: Author route-control and toll collection at the place-first owner, then add pt_toll_customs_post to a fitting PF place ref.

place:pt_watchpost_guard_post.existing_nearest_data: Town wall edge includes guarded walls and gates.
place:pt_watchpost_guard_post.why_insufficient: A small detached watchpost on road, shore or height is not necessarily a fortified town edge.
place:pt_watchpost_guard_post.minimum_data_delta: Author detached guard-post conditions at the place-first owner, then add pt_watchpost_guard_post to a fitting PF place ref.
